title: Ministry of Health — Pharmacies directory (الصيدليات): 24-hour and 12-hour pharmacies
notes: The MoH pharmacies list only covers extended-hours pharmacies, filterable as "24 ساعة" (149) or "12 ساعة" (379); 528 rows unfiltered. Name strings are as published and often embed a licence/branch number and area (e.g. "بوابة الجيزة /8/الجيزة"). is_24h/opening_hours "24/7" only for the 24-hour filter; 12-hour rows carry no explicit times. Phones are published without leading zero (e.g. 796766252) and are mostly mobiles - they are the contact numbers MoH publishes for the pharmacy. Overlaps heavily with moh_licensed_register (public pharmacies).
